descriptionChirho: To mock, make sport of, deride someone — treating them with contemptuous ridicule (Hifil active: Judg 16:10,13,15; Hifil imperfect: Jer 9:5)
To deceive, mislead, or delude someone — causing them to believe what is false (Hifil active: Gen 31:7; Job 13:9; Exod 8:29)
To be deceived or deluded — the passive (Hofal) of the deceive sense, describing the state of having been misled (Isa 44:20)
